technical-summary: rad0035: --long-prefill-tokens (cap threshold), --prefill-order arrival|remaining (least prompt left first, prefills behind keep one share), --prefill-age-ms; serving v2 tuning fields; defaults keep rad0034 step plans. Hardware: beside eight 100k prompts under cap 2, 4k-16k requests 317-433 s shipped vs 4-27 s with remaining + 16k threshold, 100k mean +10%.
user-summary-candidate: New opt-in scheduler settings let mid-size requests start in seconds instead of minutes when several long prompts are prefilling: order prefill work by what is left, and set what counts as a long prompt.
